summary: Elevate your leadership skills with our Sales Manager Leadership Excellence Training Course. Transform your team and drive sales success today!
lede: Sales leadership training helps managers guide seller execution, qualify opportunities, and make more consistent pipeline and forecast decisions. Designed for professionals who lead sales execution or develop sellers, it covers GROW and SPIN coaching, MEDDICC opportunity reviews, and CRM analysis of pipeline coverage, conversion, aging, and slippage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead sales execution, develop sellers, inspect pipeline quality, or support commercial management decisions. It suits intermediate to advanced learners who already work with customers, opportunities, targets, or sales performance data.
modules: Digital Sales Leadership and AI Workflows
prerequisites: You should have at least six months of experience supervising sales activity, managing customer opportunities, supporting sales operations, or leading account development. A working knowledge of CRM records, sales targets, pipeline stages, and basic revenue metrics is expected. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a representative, anonymized sales scenario or pipeline example for workshop use where organizational policy permits.
